description: This file defines the 'Filter' class within the Goteo project, which manages various filtering criteria for users, projects, donors, and related entities. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, validating filters, and generating SQL queries based on roles and filter parameters.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Represents filtering criteria for users, donors, projects, and related entities within the Goteo platform delivering various static and dynamic filtering functionalities, including retrieving, saving, and generating SQL queries based on roles and filter parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Filter object by its ID, along with associated projects, calls, channels, matchers, SDGs, footprints, and social commitments.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all Filter instances from the database.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a list of filters with optional pagination and count.

methods.name: getFilterProject
methods.description: Fetches projects linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterCall
methods.description: Fetches call entities linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterNode
methods.description: Fetches nodes linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterMatcher
methods.description: Fetches matchers linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterSDG
methods.description: Fetches SDGs linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterFootprint
methods.description: Fetches footprints linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilterSocialCommitments
methods.description: Fetches social commitments linked to a specific filter.

methods.name: setFilterProjects
methods.description: Updates the projects associated with the filter.

methods.name: setFilterCalls
methods.description: Updates the calls associated with the filter.

methods.name: setFilterNodes
methods.description: Updates the nodes associated with the filter.

methods.name: setFilterMatcher
methods.description: Updates the matchers associated with the filter.

methods.name: setFilterSDG
methods.description: Updates the SDGs associated with the filter.

methods.name: setFilterFootprint
methods.description: Updates the footprints associated with the filter.

methods.name: setFilterSocialCommitment
methods.description: Updates social commitments associated with the filter.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates filter data before saving, ensuring required fields are populated.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the filter in the database after validation.

methods.name: isUsed
methods.description: Checks whether the filter is referenced by other database constraints.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users matching the filter criteria, optionally with pagination and count.

methods.name: getUsersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query and parameters for fetching users based on filter.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Retrieves donors matching the filter criteria, optionally with count.

methods.name: getDonorsCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of donors matching the filter.

methods.name: getDonorsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query for fetching donors matching the filter.

methods.name: getNoDonors
methods.description: Fetches users who are not donors according to the filter.

methods.name: getNoDonorsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query for fetching non-donors.

methods.name: getPromoters
methods.description: Retrieves project promoters based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPromotersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query for project promoters.

methods.name: getMatchers
methods.description: Retrieves users matching the matcher filter criteria.

methods.name: getMatchersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query for matchers.

methods.name: getTesters
methods.description: Gets users marked as testers based on filter.

methods.name: getTestersSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for testers.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Returns filtered user/donor/promoter/role data based on role attribute.

methods.name: getFilteredSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL query and parameters based on role.
